title: Gotrade Daily: Anthropic Debut and Walmart Results Tonight
summary: Anthropic starts trading on Nasdaq as ANT after an $81.3 billion IPO. Walmart reports third-quarter results before the open.
body_markdown:
### Walmart before the open


**Walmart ([WMT](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/wmt/) )** reports fiscal third-quarter 2027 results before the open, with an EPS estimate of $0.64,[according to Nasdaq's earnings calendar](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/earnings) . It reports a day after Target, Lowe's and TJX, giving the next read on US consumer spending.


### Palo Alto after its first-quarter report


**Palo Alto Networks ([PANW](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/panw/) )** posted fiscal first-quarter 2027 revenue of $3.44 billion, up 39% from a year earlier, and adjusted EPS of $1.05. Analysts expected $3.31 billion and $0.97,[according to CNBC, citing LSEG](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/18/palo-alto-networks-panw-q1-2027-earnings-.html) .


The company raised its full-year guidance and agreed to buy AI startup Applied Compute in a $4.5 billion all-stock deal. More in[our Palo Alto story](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/palo-alto-networks-fiscal-q1-2027-earnings/) .


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


As of 8:22 p.m. ET on Wednesday, S&P 500 futures were up 0.8% at 7,395.25, Nasdaq 100 futures up 1.3% at 27,528.75 and Dow futures up 0.4% at 50,488,[according to Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/wall-street-futures-climb-ahead-of-anthropics-15-trillion-mega-ipo-5037518) .


## Macro Note 📝


Minutes of the Fed's October meeting showed officials still concerned about inflation and open to further rate increases. Some said a 50 basis point hike could be warranted if inflation data stayed unfavorable, according to Investing.com. Traders price a near-certain 25 basis point hike in December, according to CME FedWatch.


The[Philadelphia Fed](https://www.philadelphiafed.org/surveys-and-data/regional-economic-analysis/manufacturing-business-outlook-survey) manufacturing survey and weekly jobless claims come out at 8:30 a.m. ET.


## Conclusion


Tonight tests investor appetite for the largest IPO on record, after the S&P 500 fell for a fifth straight session. Walmart's results before the open give the next read on US consumer spending.


US markets open at 9:30 a.m. ET.
